errorCodes.meaning: the invocation is wrong: fix it, do not retry it as is
what was named is not there, or this key cannot see it: look it up with a list command; kind and name say what, available what there is
a name fits more than one thing, listed in candidates: name it more precisely
Linear refused the request; error has its words
Linear could not be reached, timed out or answered 5xx: rerunning is safe
anything else that failed; error says what
another run holds a lock; nothing changed: retry
no API key, or Linear rejected it
Linear's budget is spent: retry after retryAt
a precondition such as --if-updated-at no longer holds: read again
